newsitem.title: USA: U.S. government's surplus jumped in December.
newsitem.headline: U.S. government's surplus jumped in December.

text.p: The government posted a surprisingly big budget surplus in December that was nearly quadruple the surplus it achieved a year earlier, the Treasury Department said Thursday.

Revenues exceeded spending by $19.36 billion in December, far above the $10.4 billion surplus that Wall Street analysts had forecast, compared with a surplus a year earlier in December 1995 of $5.28 billion.
December's surplus followed a November deficit of $37.88 billion.

The end of the year typically produces strong revenues since many companies make estimated tax payments on a quarterly basis. Many corporations reported improved profits last year as the economic expansion entered a sixth year.
Income or receipts, mostly from taxes, climbed to $148.49 billion in December from $97.85 billion in November and was up from $138.35 billion in December 1995.
Total outlays in December were $129.13 billion, down from $135.73 billion in November and down from $133.06 billion in December 1995.

"The implications certainly are important in that it certainly suports the notion that the budget deficit will be low again this year," said economist Kathleen Stephansen of Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp. in New York.
During the first three months of fiscal 1997, which ends on Sept. 30, the cumulative deficit was up modestly to $58.78 billion from $55.75 billion in the comparable three-month period of fiscal 1996.
The last published estimate of the government's anticipated fiscal 1997 budget deficit was $125.7 billion, up from a shortfall of $107.28 billion in fiscal 1996.
But a revised fiscal 1997 estimate will be issued when the Clinton administration makes its fiscal 1998 budget presentation to Congress on Feb 6.

Stephansen said she currently estimated a fiscal 1997 deficit around $110 billion but that could change if there were further monthly improvements in the budget on the order of that recorded in December.
